name: One-Point Amalgam of Two Squares
definition: $\{0000,0100,1000,1100,0001,0010,0011\}\subseteq\{0,1\}^4$, the union of two coordinate squares meeting only at $0000$.
properties: It lies in the maximum tree-amalgam closure and is ample of VC dimension two. It is not maximum: it has seven concepts, whereas the Sauer bound on four active coordinates is eleven. It is not cubical-face-prime, since its two square factors strictly contain their common one-vertex cube face.
